name: Pop Art Comic
description: A retro pop-art comic page: yellow stock with Ben-Day dots and speed rays, heavy black panel borders with hard offset shadows, outlined comic titles that slam in on a dutch angle, caption boxes, speech-bubble chats, starburst halos, action-burst stamps and a printed dot screen. Every element slams in with an overshoot and every scene is a new panel slammed in on a diagonal with speed lines and an impact burst. Loud, fun and fast. No emoji.
prompt_hint: Write 8-12 fast scenes (3-5 s each) like comic panels. title.main punchy (2-5 words, set in caps); title.kicker reads like a caption box; use title.number for countdowns. visual.type "illustration" with 1-3 bold elements: chat (rendered as speech bubbles), icon (size l, on a burst), badge, compare, counter, stamp (an action burst with one word such as BOOM or NOPE). Never use emoji.
